K.description: even central identity, identified with scalar 1; not a basis element

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: [b_j^s, a_1^sigma] = -gb_{sigma,j,s} kappa; [X,Y}_gamma = [X,Y}_0 + kappa*gamma(X,Y); gamma linear in gb; odd generators Weyl-symmetrised
inhomogeneous_deformation.gamma_convention: kappa placed to the left: kappa*Z; gamma(X,Y) has parity p(X)+p(Y)+1
